<script setup lang="ts">
import {
	AlertDialogRoot,
	useForwardPropsEmits,
	type AlertDialogEmits,
	type AlertDialogProps
} from 'reka-ui';

// Use `v-model:open` to control it from outside.
const props = defineProps<AlertDialogProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<AlertDialogEmits>();
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
	<AlertDialogRoot v-bind="forwarded">
		<slot />
	</AlertDialogRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AlertDialogAction } from 'reka-ui';
import { Button, type ButtonSize, type ButtonVariant } from '../button/index.js';

// Confirms: runs its @click, then closes. `<AlertDialog.Action @click="remove">`.
const { variant = 'default', size } = defineProps<{ variant?: ButtonVariant; size?: ButtonSize }>();
</script>

<template>
	<AlertDialogAction as-child>
		<Button :variant="variant" :size="size"><slot /></Button>
	</AlertDialogAction>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AlertDialogCancel } from 'reka-ui';
import { Button, type ButtonSize, type ButtonVariant } from '../button/index.js';

// Closes without doing anything. Reka focuses it when the dialog opens.
const { variant = 'outline', size } = defineProps<{ variant?: ButtonVariant; size?: ButtonSize }>();
</script>

<template>
	<AlertDialogCancel as-child>
		<Button :variant="variant" :size="size"><slot /></Button>
	</AlertDialogCancel>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AlertDialogTrigger } from 'reka-ui';
import { Button, type ButtonSize, type ButtonVariant } from '../button/index.js';

// Renders our Button, so it takes the same variant and size props.
const { variant = 'default', size } = defineProps<{ variant?: ButtonVariant; size?: ButtonSize }>();
</script>

<template>
	<AlertDialogTrigger as-child>
		<Button :variant="variant" :size="size"><slot /></Button>
	</AlertDialogTrigger>
</template>
